# Function: SalesReports\_DisplayQueryReport

* * *

## 1 Overview

This function requests the display of a query report.

With no options, the query report is displayed with sales data from the current day, created by the requesting agent UserID and Organizationin the requesting office in the default currency of the office.

  
  

## 1.1 Supported Operations

Request reported data issued:

-   1-without options
-   2-for all the agents of the office (SOF)
-   3-in all offices sharing the same IATA number (SAN)
-   4-for a specific agent sign (SAS-xxx)
-   5-by all agents in a specific office (SOF-xxxxxxxxx)
-   6-for all related STP offices (SOF/P)
-   7-for a specific agent LSS long UID (SAS-xxx)
-   8-for a supervisor to request the sales of another agent UID/ORGA (SUS-xxxxxxxxxx/xxxxxxxxxx)
-   9-for a specific STP office (SOF/P-xxxxxxxxxx)
-   10-for all related TDO offices (SOF/O)
-   11-in a specific Stock Provider (A-XXX or T-XX)  
    If transactions issued using the new Low Cost Carriers content platform are requested, this option needs to be used at the same time with the Distribution Method option.
-   12-in a specific Distribution Method  (M-x)  
    This option needs to be used at the same time with theStock Provider option (in j-), in order to request new Low Cost Carriers content.
-   13-for all the standard EDI sales (ETK)
-   14-for all the NDC-X reported sales (NDC)
-   15-for all the NDC-X reported and non-reported sales (NDC/ALL)
-   16-for all the NDC-X non reported sales (AL-ALL)
-   17-for a specific airline NDC-X non reported sales (AL-XX where XX is the airline code)

Request reported data by:

-   18-transaction code (QTX-xxxx)
-   19-transaction type (QTC-xxxx)
-   20-original issue transaction code (QOC-xxxx)
-   21-validating carrier/ticket provider (QVP-xx or QOP-XXX)
-   22-client code (QCL-xx)
-   23-credit card vendor code (QCC-xx)
-   24-fop type (QFP-xx)
-   25-sales indicator (QSI-xxx)
-   26-currency code (C-xxx)
-   27-date (D-ddMMM)
-   28-time period (D-ddMMMddMMM)
-   29-voided documents (V)
-   30-scrolling - 50 first rows
-   31-scrolling - last 50 rows
-   32-refund reason (QRR-XX)
-   33-pricing indicator

Request reported data from:

-   34-item sequence number (I-xxxxxx)
-   35-ticket number (F-xxxxxxxxxx)
-   36-provider booking reference (B-xxx)

## 1.2 Limitations

The number of items we may return in the response is technically limited to 4 Mo. In the case reply contains more than 4Mo, it cannot be processed.  
  
The workaround to cope with this limitation is to use more specific search criteria.  
\- you should either use a search option (e.g. formOfPaymentDetails, currencyInfo,dateDetails...)  
\- or use the scrolling, as described below (actionDetails), providing a fixed number of documents to be returned in the response

## 1.3 Unsupported Operations

Not applicable

## 1.4 Prerequisites

Signed Agent Assembly Area (AAA).

Central Ticketing Server is the ticketing server of the requesting office.

## 2 Building A Query

There might be data related to the originator of the query, and possible options which are described in the operations.

Chapter _**5.Operations**_ contains detailed examples on how to build a query.

## 2.1 Sub Structure: Action Details

## 2.1.1 Description

This substructure conveys details used to handle the scrolling request. It is composed of:

-   The <numberOfItemsDetails> containing only one element: the <numberOfItems\>. The <numberOfItems\> element conveys the number of items requested to be returned in the reply.
-   The <lastItemsDetails\> containing only one element: the <lastItemIdentifer>. The <lastItemIdentifer> element can be:
    -   empty for a first query
    -   the last sales report number received in the previous reply of the scrolling request.

## 2.1.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<actionDetails> <numberOfItemsDetails> <numberOfItems>50</numberOfItems> </numberOfItemsDetails> <lastItemsDetails> <lastItemIdentifier>23</lastItemIdentifier> </lastItemsDetails> </actionDetails>

## 2.2 Sub Structure: Agency Details

## 2.2.1 Description

This substructure conveys agency information.

This sub structure is composed of:

-   The <sourceType\> element which contains the <sourceQualifier1> element which can have 3 values:
    -   "REP" for reporting agency.
    -   "STP" for a STP (Satellite Ticket printer) office
    -   "TDO" for a TDO (Ticket Delivery Office) office

-   The <originatorDetails\> which is composed of :
    -   The <originatorId\> which conveys the IATA number of the agency.
    -   The <inHouseIdentification1> element which conveys the Amadeus Office ID of the agency.

## 2.2.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<agencyDetails> <sourceType> <sourceQualifier1>REP</sourceQualifier1> </sourceType> <originatorDetails> <inHouseIdentification1>TYO6X0101</inHouseIdentification1> </originatorDetails> </agencyDetails>

## 2.3 Sub Structure: Agent User Details

## 2.3.1 Description

It conveys the agent sign or the agent LSS Login. When requesting a sales report for transactions issued by a specific agent of the requester office ID, this substructure should be used.

This sub structure is composed of:

-   The <originIdentification> which contains the transaction <originatorID> which conveys the agent sign

 OR

-    The <originIdentification\> which contains the transaction <originatorID> which conveys the agent UserID and Organizationin

OR

-   <originator> which conveys the agent LSS Login

## 2.3.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<agentUserDetails> <originIdentification> <originatorId>0001AA</originatorId> </originIdentification> </agentUserDetails>

## 2.4 Sub Structure: Currency Info

## 2.4.1 Description

It conveys the information of currency. When requesting a sales report for transactions issued on a specific currency, this substructure should be used.

This substructure si composed of:

-   a currency Details group composed of:
    -   a currency qualifier: value must be 3 when requesting for a currency different from the default one. 
    -   currency Iso code. it conveys the 3 character currency Iso Code.

## 2.4.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<currencyInfo> <currencyDetails> <currencyQualifier>3</currencyQualifier> <currencyIsoCode>USD</currencyIsoCode> </currencyDetails> </currencyInfo>

## 2.5 Sub Structure: Date Details

## 2.5.1 Description

It conveys the information of date. When requesting a sales report for transactions issued on a specific date. This substructure should be used.

The date needs to be entered in the "Structured Date Time Information" section which contains:

\- Year number

\- Month number

\- Day number

## 2.5.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<dateDetails> <dateTime> <year>2014</year> <month>10</month> <day>28</day> </dateTime> </dateDetails>

## 2.6 Sub Structure: Distribution Method

## 2.6.1 Description

This sub-structure conveys the information on the Product through which requested transactions were issued, and therefore is used specifically when requesting a report of transactions issued via EAC product.

This sub structure is composed of the <methodCode\> element which conveys the Product value, which is 'O' for EAC product.

In the query, both Stock Provider Details and Distribution Method substructures must be present, in order to display EAC content.  
  

## 2.6.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<distributionMethod> <methodCode>O</methodCode> </distributionMethod>

## 2.7 Sub Structure: Form of Payment Details

## 2.7.1 Description

It conveys optional details on the form of payment, or the credit card company name to target given documents in a sales report.

The substructure is composed of:

-   The <formOfPayment\> containing elements: the <type> which conveys the form of payment type, the <vendorCode\> which conveys credit card vendor code.

## 2.7.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<formOfPaymentDetails> <formOfPayment> <type>CA</type> </formOfPayment> </formOfPaymentDetails>

## 2.8 Sub Structure: From Sequence DocumentNumber

## 2.8.1 Description

It conveys an optional sequence or document number to sort the transactions report showing only the documents starting from the particular document which has the sequence/document number.

The substructure is composed of :

-   The <itemNumberDetails>  containing elements: the <number> which can be sequence number(up to 6 figures) or document number(7 to 10 figures), the <type> which conveys type of the number

## 2.8.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<fromSequenceDocumentNumber> <itemNumberDetails> <number>64</number> <type>S</type> </itemNumberDetails> </fromSequenceDocumentNumber>

## 2.9 Sub Structure: Request Option

## 2.9.1 Description

This substructure conveys an option to request a sales report for:  
\- all agents in the office.  
\- all offices sharing the same IATA number  
\- all STP/STDO offices  
\- a STP/STDO office  
\- all TDO offices  
\- a TDO office.  
\- only net remit documents.

This substructure conveys the security options and the cross reference qualifiers. It is composed of 2 identical elements called:

-   The <selectionDetails\>
-   The <otherSelectionDetails\>

These groups are composed of the following element: 

-   <option> which can take the different values:
    -   "SOF" when requesting a report on all agents of an office
    -   "STP" when requesting a report on an STP (Satellite Ticket Printer) location
    -   "TDO" when requesting a report on a TDO (Ticket Delivery Office) location
    -   "BNR" when requesting a report on a BNR(Net Remit Qualifier)
    -   "SAN" when requesting a repott on a SAN (All offices sharing the same IATA number)

## 2.9.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<requestOption> <selectionDetails> <option>SOF</option> </selectionDetails> <otherSelectionDetails> <option>SAN</option> </otherSelectionDetails> </requestOption>

## 2.10 Sub Structure: Reservation Information

## 2.10.1 Description

This substructure conveys reservation control number reference from other entities. For Rail transactions, it can convey the Distributor reference for the Sale, associated with the Company identification.

## 2.10.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<reservationInformation> <reservation> <companyId>FRR</companyId> <controlNumber>123AB456</controlNumber> </reservation> </reservationInformation>

## 2.11 Sub Structure: Sales Indicator

## 2.11.1 Description

This substructure is used when requesting a sales report on domestic or international sales only.

The information is conveyed in <statusInformation> element under the <type> element and can take the following values:

-   "DOM" for domestic sales
-   "INT" for international sales.
-   "RR" to precise refund reason
-   "V" for voided documents

This substructure is also used when requesting a query report with a filtering on pricing indicator (auto/manual). A Query report of REFUND documents having the specified pricing indicator are returned. 

When this filtering option on pricing indicator is used, the specified pricing indicator is conveyed in the <statusInformation>:

-   PRI (pricing indicator) stored in <indicator>
-   AUT (automated) or MAN (manual) stored in <action>

When filtering option on pricing indicator is not used, neither <indicator> PRI nor AUT/MAN <action> must be encoded in the request message.

Upon activation, a Query report of all documents having the specified pricing indicator are returned.

This substructure is also used when requesting a query report with a filtering on standard EDI sales or NDC-X sales.

A fisrt codeset is added in the <indicator> element:

**ETK** to convey standard EDI sales

A second codeset is added in the <indicator> element:

**NDC** to convey NDC-X reported sales

-   An optionnal sub filtering option is added in the <action> element in order to be used with **NDC**:
-   **ALL** to convey All NDC-X reported and non reported sales

A third codeset is added in the <indicator> element:  
  
**AL** to convey NDC-X non reported sales

-   A mandatory sub filtering options are added in the <description> element in order to be used with **AL** :
-   **ALL** to convey the NDC-X non reported sales of all the airlines
-   or **XX**  to convey the NDC-X non reported sales of a specific airline (XX is the airline code)

## 2.11.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<salesIndicator> <statusInformation> <type>DOM</type> </statusInformation> </salesIndicator>

## 2.12 Sub Structure: Sales Period Details

## 2.12.1 Description

It conveys the information of date range. When requesting a sales report for transactions issued on a specific date range. This substructure should be used.

this substructure is composed of groups:

-   Begin Date Time which conveys:
    -   The year number
    -   The month number
    -   The day number
-   End Date Time
    -   The year number
    -   The month number
    -   The day number

## 2.12.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<salesPeriodDetails> <beginDateTime> <year>2014</year> <month>10</month> <day>28</day> </beginDateTime> <endDateTime> <year>2014</year> <month>10</month> <day>29</day> </endDateTime> </salesPeriodDetails>

## 2.13 Sub Structure: Stock Provider Details

## 2.13.1 Description

It conveys the information of the airline stock provider of transactions issued using the new Low Cost Carriers content platform. It is used when requesting a report of new Low Cost Carriers content (non-GDS sales).

This sub structure is composed of:

-   The industry sector ( <travelSector\> element )
    -   "AIR" for AIR transactions (default if blank)
-   The customer code ( <companyCode\> element )
    -   2-chars AL Code for AIR

In the query, both Stock Provider Details and Distribution Method substructures must be present, in order to display new Low Cost Carriers content.  
In the XML example below, the stock provider is U2.

## 2.13.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<stockProviderDetails> <travelSector>AIR</travelSector> <companyCode>U2</companyCode> </stockProviderDetails>

## 2.14 Sub Structure: Transaction Data

## 2.14.1 Description

It conveys optional transaction code and/or transaction type to target given documents in a sales report.

The substructure is composed of:

-   The <transactionDetails\> containing elements: the <code> which conveys Transaction Code, the <type> which conveys Transaction Type, the <issueIndicator\> which can have values "C" (Current transaction code) or "O" (Original transaction code).

## 2.14.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<transactionData> <transactionDetails> <code>TKTT</code> <type>SALE</type> <issueIndicator>O</issueIndicator> </transactionDetails> </transactionData>

## 2.15 Sub Structure: Validating Carrier Details

## 2.15.1 Description

It conveys the validating carrier or the airline stock provider detail.

This substructure si composed of the <companyIdentification> which contains the <marketingCompany\> element which convey the airline stock provider 2 lettercode.

## 2.15.2 Xml Structure

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<validatingCarrierDetails> <companyIdentification> <marketingCompany>6X</marketingCompany> </companyIdentification> </validatingCarrierDetails>

## 3 Receiving A Reply

In case the sales data are successfully sent, the reply contains:  
  
1) a Header containing the requesting details:  
  
    Amadeus office identification and agency IATA number (<requestorAgencyDetails>)  
    agent UserID and Organization + Agent long login (<agentDetails>)  
    agent short login + agent full name(<agentOtherUserDetails>)  
    currency (<currencyInfo>)  
    date (<dateDetails>)  
    sales report date (<dateDetails>)  
  
2) the list of transactions containing each one, the following information:  
  

    sequence number (<sequenceIdentification>)  
    document number (<documentNumber>)  
    total document amount, commission, tax, fee (<monetaryInformation>)  
    VAT amount (present only for specific markets) (<monetaryInformation>, VAT codeset)  
    agent amount (present only for specific markets) (<monetaryInformation>, AGT codeset)  
    fop code (<fopDetails>)  
    pax name (<passengerName>)  
    booking agents sign + booking Agent long login (<bookingAgent>)  
    booking agent short login + agent full name (<bookingAgentOtherUserDetails>)  
    pnr (<reservationInformation>)

    transaction code (<transactionDataDetails>)

    pricing indicator (<pricingIndicator>)

  
If the reply contains an error, the error code/description if anyis displayed.

Chapter _**5.1.2 Reply Structure**_ contains an example of a standard reply.

## 3.1 Sub Structure: Action Details

## 3.1.1 Description

It conveys the details used for scrolling requests. It is composed of:

-   <numberOfItemsDetails> which contains the <numberofItems> element. This element can have one value:
    -   "0" when to specify that the reply contains the last scrollable items.
-   <lastItemsDetails\> whcich contains the <lastItemIdentifier\> element. This element contains the item number (here the sales report number) of the last item sent in the response

## 3.1.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<actionDetails> <lastItemsDetails> <lastItemIdentifier>2</lastItemIdentifier> </lastItemsDetails> </actionDetails>

* * *

## 3.2 Sub Structure: Agent Details

## 3.2.1 Description

It conveys the agent sign details related to the agent or user associated to the requested sales report.

This sub structure is composed of:

-    The <originIdentification\> which contains the transaction <originatorID> which conveys the agent UserID and Organization
-   The originator which conveys the LSS long login of the agent who did the transaction (sales ou refund or void)

## 3.2.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<agentDetails> <originIdentification> <originatorId>CURSIGN</originatorId> </originIdentification> <originator>USERID/ORGA</originator> </agentDetails>

* * *

## 3.3 Sub Structure: Agent Other User Details

## 3.3.1 Description

conveys short login of the agent who requests the sales report with codeset SLG and the agent full name of the agent who requests the sales report with codeset AGN

The substucture is composed of:

For the short login of the agent :

-   The <criteriaSetType\> which is set to SLG
-   The <criteriaDetails\> composed of the <attributeType> which is LSS user ID or Agent short login.

For the agent full name :

-   The <criteriaSetType> which is set to AGN
-   The <criteriaDetails> composed of the <attributeType> which is the Agent Full Name

## 3.3.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<agentOtherUserDetails> <criteriaSetType>SLG</criteriaSetType> <criteriaDetails> <attributeType>RKMA2N945</attributeType> </criteriaDetails> </agentOtherUserDetails> <agentOtherUserDetails> <criteriaSetType>AGN</criteriaSetType> <criteriaDetails> <attributeType>LASTNAME FIRST NAME</attributeType> </criteriaDetails> </agentOtherUserDetails>

* * *

## 3.4 Sub Structure: Booking Agent

## 3.4.1 Description

It conveys Booking agent sine of the document in sales report. The substructure is composed of :

The <originIdentification\> composed of:

-   The <originatorId\> which conveys agent sine.
-   The originator which conveys the LSS long login of the agent who did the transaction (sales ou refund or void)

## 3.4.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<bookingAgent> <originIdentification> <originatorId>0001XVSU</originatorId> </originIdentification> </bookingAgent>

* * *

## 3.5 Sub Structure: Booking Agent Other User Details

## 3.5.1 Description

conveys short login of the agent who did the transaction (sales, refund, void ...) with codeset SLG and the agent full name of the agent who did the transaction with codeset AGN

The substucture is composed of :

For the short login of the agent :

-   The <criteriaSetType> which is set to SLG

-   The <criteriaDetails> composed of the <attributeType> which is LSS user ID or Agent short login.

  
For the agent full name :

-   The <criteriaSetType> which is set to AGN

-   The <criteriaDetails> composed of the <attributeType> which is the Agent Full Name

## 3.5.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<bookingAgentOtherUserDetails> <criteriaSetType>SLG</criteriaSetType> <criteriaDetails> <attributeType>RKMA2N945</attributeType> </criteriaDetails> </bookingAgentOtherUserDetails> <bookingAgentOtherUserDetails> <criteriaSetType>AGN</criteriaSetType> <criteriaDetails> <attributeType>LASTNAME FIRST NAME</attributeType> </criteriaDetails> </bookingAgentOtherUserDetails>

* * *

## 3.6 Sub Structure: Currency Info

## 3.6.1 Description

It conveys the information of currency.

This substructure si composed of:

-   The <currencyDetails\> element composed of:
    -   The <currencyQualifier\>: value must be 3 when requesting for a currency different from the default one. 
    -   The <currencyIsoCode\>. it conveys the 3 character currency Iso Code.

## 3.6.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<currencyInfo> <currencyDetails> <currencyQualifier>2</currencyQualifier> <currencyIsoCode>EUR</currencyIsoCode> </currencyDetails> </currencyInfo>

* * *

## 3.7 Sub Structure: Date Details

## 3.7.1 Description

This substructure conveys the date information. It is composed of 

-   The <businessSemantic\> element which can take the following values:
    -   "S" for specific date
    -   "C" for the current date
-   The <dateTime\> element which contains the following elements:
    
    -   The <year> for the year number
    
    -   The <month> for the month number
    
    -   The <day> for the day number

## 3.7.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<dateDetails> <businessSemantic>C</businessSemantic> <dateTime> <year>2009</year> <month>10</month> <day>16</day> </dateTime> </dateDetails>

* * *

## 3.8 Sub Structure: Document Data

## 3.8.1 Description

This substructure conveys data related to a document.It is composed of following substuctures

-   The <sequenceIdentification\> substructure
-   The <documentNumber\> substructure
-   The <monetaryInformation> substructure
-   The <bookingAgent\> substructure
-   The <bookingAgentOtherUserDetails> substructure
-   The <transactionDataDetails> substructure
-   The <fopDetails\> substructure
-   The <passengerName\> substructure
-   The <enhancedPaxInfoCriteria> substructure
-   The <reservationInformation> substructure

## 3.8.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<documentData> <sequenceIdentification> <itemNumberDetails> <number>162</number> <type>S</type> </itemNumberDetails> </sequenceIdentification> <documentNumber> <documentDetails> <number>0571122330359</number> <numberOfBooklets>1</numberOfBooklets> </documentDetails> <status>CS</status> </documentNumber> <monetaryInformation> <monetaryDetails> <typeQualifier>712</typeQualifier> <amount>508.00</amount> </monetaryDetails> <otherMonetaryDetails> <typeQualifier>TTX</typeQualifier> <amount>64.20</amount> </otherMonetaryDetails> <otherMonetaryDetails> <typeQualifier>F</typeQualifier> <amount>0.00</amount> </otherMonetaryDetails> <otherMonetaryDetails> <typeQualifier>OB</typeQualifier> <amount>30.00</amount> </otherMonetaryDetails> <otherMonetaryDetails> <typeQualifier>T</typeQualifier> <amount>602.20</amount> </otherMonetaryDetails> </monetaryInformation> <bookingAgent> <originIdentification> <originatorId>0001AASU</originatorId> </originIdentification> <originator>RAGHURAMANAKUMAR?^!ab#GAMA\_MANAKALALALALAKALAAL</originator> </bookingAgent> <bookingAgentOtherUserDetails> <criteriaSetType>SLG</criteriaSetType> <criteriaDetails> <agentShortLogin>RAGHURAM</agentShortLogin> </criteriaDetails> </bookingAgentOtherUserDetails> <transactionDataDetails> <transactionDetails> <code>TKTM</code> <type>SALE</type> <issueIndicator>C</issueIndicator> </transactionDetails> </transactionDataDetails> <fopDetails> <fopDescription> <formOfPayment> <type>CA</type> </formOfPayment> </fopDescription> <monetaryInfo> <monetaryDetails> <typeQualifier>FP</typeQualifier> <amount>602.20</amount> </monetaryDetails> </monetaryInfo> </fopDetails> <passengerName> <paxDetails> <surname>AF/TRMD</surname> </paxDetails> </passengerName> <reservationInformation> <reservation> <controlNumber>5JWAYS</controlNumber> </reservation> </reservationInformation> </documentData>

* * *

## 3.9 Sub Structure: Document Details

## 3.9.1 Description

For generic transactions (for example Rail Transactions), this elements conveys the provider document number (for Rail transactions, Distributor Document Number).

his substructure conveys information regarding the document number. It is composed of: 

-   The document details number composed of:
    -   The provider document number (alphanum)
-   The status which can take the following values:
    -   DOC for Document Number

## 3.9.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

* * *

## 3.10 Sub Structure: Document Number

## 3.10.1 Description

This substructure conveys the last 10 digits of the document number. It is composed of:

The <documentDetails\> element which contains:

-   The <number> element which conveys the 10 digits document number.
-   The <numberOfBooklets\> which conveys total no of tickets incase of conjunctive.

The <status> which conveys status on the document in the sales report: it can be confirmed or not.

## 3.10.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<documentNumber> <documentDetails> <number>2154901848</number> </documentDetails> <status>C</status> </documentNumber>

* * *

## 3.11 Sub Structure: Enhanced Pax Info Criteria

## 3.11.1 Description

This substructure conveys the passenger name information when the passenger exists in non latin charcaters. It is composed of

-   The <travellerNameInfo> composed of:
    -   The <qualifier>
    -   The <quantity>
    -   The <type> which is a passenger type as defined by IATA
    -   The <otherType> which is a passenger type as defined by IATA
    -   The <uniqueCustomerIdentifier\>
    -   The <infantIndicator\> which value is "I" in case of infant
-   The <otherPaxNamesDetails> composed of:
    -   The <nameType>:
        -   NN1 for romanizable native name
        -   NN2 for non-romanizable native name
        -   RN1 for Romanization of native name 1 in ASCII domain
        -   RN2 for Romanization of native name 1 in extended ASCII domain
        -   UN for universal name
    -   The <referenceName> which can take 2 values: "Y" for yes or "N' for no
    -   The <displayedName> which can take 2 values: "Y" for yes or "N' for no
    -   THe <romanizationMethod>
    -   The <surname>
    -   THe <givenName\>
    -   The <title>

## 3.11.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<enhancedPaxInfoCriteria> <travellerNameInfo> <quantity>1</quantity> </travellerNameInfo> <otherPaxNamesDetails> <nameType>NN1</nameType> <surname>김</surname> <givenName>지훈</givenName> </otherPaxNamesDetails> </enhancedPaxInfoCriteria>

* * *

## 3.12 Sub Structure: Error Group

## 3.12.1 Description

This sub structure conveys a potential warning or error message. It is composed of:

-   The error or warning code details composed of:
    -   The error code which conveys the canned message number
    -   The error category which can have the following values:
        -   EC for an error
        -   WEC for a warning
    -   The error code owner (ex: 3 for IATA)
-   The error /warning description which is composed of:
    -   The free text details with the text subjectqualifier filled with "1", the source which is always filled with "M" and the encoding.
    -   The free text filled with the error or warning message in free text

## 3.12.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<errorGroup> <errorOrWarningCodeDetails> <errorDetails> <errorCode>6466</errorCode> <errorCategory>EC</errorCategory> <errorCodeOwner>3</errorCodeOwner> </errorDetails> </errorOrWarningCodeDetails> <errorWarningDescription> <freeTextDetails> <textSubjectQualifier>1</textSubjectQualifier> <source>M</source> <encoding>1</encoding> </freeTextDetails> <freeText>NO DATA FOUND</freeText> </errorWarningDescription> </errorGroup>

* * *

## 3.13 Sub Structure: Fop Description

## 3.13.1 Description

This substructure conveys the information of the FOP associated to the document in sales report. It is composed of:

-   The <type> which convey the FOP type 
-   The <indicator> which conveys the FOP Indicator
-   The <amount> which conveys the amount associated with FOP.
-   The vendor code. This data is present in case of payment by form of payment CC (VI, AX, CA, etc...)
-   The credit card number. This data is present in case of payment by form of payment CC
-   The expiry date. This data is present in case of payment by form of payment CC
-   The approval code. This data is present in case of payment by form of payment CC
-   The source of approval code. This data is present in case of payment by form of payment CC.

## 3.13.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<fopDescription> <formOfPayment> <type>CA</type> </formOfPayment> </fopDescription>

* * *

## 3.14 Sub Structure: Fop Details

## 3.14.1 Description

This substructure conveys data related to the FOP.It is composed of following substuctures

-   The <fopDescription\> substructure
-   The <monetaryInfo\> substructure

## 3.14.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

* * *

## 3.15 Sub Structure: Monetary Info

## 3.15.1 Description

This substructure convey monetary amount. It is composed of 2 identical groups called <monetaryDetails> and <otherMonetaryDetails\> they are composed of:

-   The <typeQualifier\> element which takes only values: "FP" for FOP amount or "M" for ticket total amount or "T" for ticket document amount.
-   The <amount> element which convey the amount
-   The <currency> which conveys the currency of the amount.

## 3.15.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<monetaryInfo> <monetaryDetails> <typeQualifier>M</typeQualifier> <amount>610.35</amount> <currency>EUR</currency> </monetaryDetails> </monetaryInfo>

* * *

## 3.16 Sub Structure: Monetary Information

## 3.16.1 Description

This substructure convey the document total amount.

It is composed of 2 identical groups called <monetaryDetails>, which is not repeatable, and <otherMonetaryDetails\>, which is repeatable. The repeatability of group <otherMonetaryDetails> is to convey all different types of monetary information of the document. Each of these 2 groups is composed of:

-   The <typeQualifier\> type of the amount.
-   The <amount> element which convey the amount
-   The <currency> which conveys the currency of the amount.

## 3.16.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<monetaryInformation> <monetaryDetails> <typeQualifier>M</typeQualifier> <amount>610.35</amount> <currency>EUR</currency> </monetaryDetails> </monetaryInformation>

* * *

## 3.17 Sub Structure: NDCX related data

## 3.17.1 Description

It conveys the NDCX related  data. This sub structure is composed of:

The <orderID> which conveys the order id 

The <orderItemID> which conveys the order item id 

The <statusDetails\> which is composed of :

-   The <indicator> ''NDC'' is present if the transaction is NDCX 

-   The <indicator>RI for NDC reporting indicator 
-   Whose  <action> are ; BSP if transaction is reported to BSP
-                                    ARC if transaction is reported to ARC
-                                    AL if transaction is reported to airline

## 3.18 Sub Structure: Passenger Name

## 3.18.1 Description

This substructure conveys the passenger name it is composed of the <paxDetails\> element containing the <surname> element which is the passenger surname followed by a "/" followed by the passenger first name and <type> which conveys passengery type.

## 3.18.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<passengerName> <paxDetails> <surname>SANDEEP/DABBADI</surname> <type>700</type> </paxDetails> </passengerName>

* * *

## 3.19 Sub Structure: Pricing Indicator

## 3.19.1 Description

It conveys the pricing indicator in <pricingIndicator\>, under the sub-substructure <indicators>:

-   "A" for automated pricing
-   "M" for manual pricing

In case the pricing indicator flag auto/manual has not been computed for a given document (because the document is not part of the list of documents supported by the pricing indicator computation logic expl: CANX, CANN documents are not subject to pricing indicator computation), the <pricingIndicator> structure is not present.

In below example, the concerned document was manually priced.

## 3.19.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<pricingIndicator> <priceTicketDetails> <indicators>A</indicators> </priceTicketDetails> </pricingIndicator>

* * *

## 3.22 Sub Structure: Requestor Agency Details

## 3.22.1 Description

It conveys the data related to the requestor's agency.The substructure is composed of:

The <sourceType\> composed of following elements:

-   The <sourceQualifier1> which conveys source qualifier reporting office.
-   The <sourceQualifier2> which indicates that data are associated to all agencies sharing the same IATA number.

The <originatorDetails\> composed of following elements:

-   The <originatorId\> which conveys IATA number of the agency.
-   The <inHouseIdentification1> which conveys office ID of the agency.

## 3.22.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<requestorAgencyDetails> <sourceType> <sourceQualifier1>REP</sourceQualifier1> </sourceType> <originatorDetails> <originatorId>20492231</originatorId> <inHouseIdentification1>BIQ6X00OB</inHouseIdentification1> </originatorDetails> </requestorAgencyDetails>

* * *

## 3.23 Sub Structure: Reservation Information

## 3.23.1 Description

It conveys the Reservation information. 

This sub structure is composed of:

-   The <reservation> composed of:
    -   The <controlNumber\> conveying Reservation control Number: RLoc of the PNR.

  
This substructure can also convey reservation control number reference from other entities. For Rail transactions, it can convey the Distributor reference for the Sale, associated with the Company identification.  

## 3.23.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<reservationInformation> <reservation> <controlNumber>ABC213</controlNumber> </reservation> </reservationInformation>

* * *

## 3.24 Sub Structure: Sales Period Details

## 3.24.1 Description

This substructure conveys the sales report period (start and end dates). It is composed of:

-   The <beginDateTime\> element which is composed of:
    -   The <year> number
    -   The <month> number
    -   The <day> number
-   The <endDateTime> element which is conmposed of:
    -   The <year> number
    -   The <month> number
    -   The <day> number

## 3.24.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<salesPeriodDetails> <beginDateTime> <year>2015</year> <month>3</month> <day>29</day> </beginDateTime> <endDateTime> <year>2015</year> <month>3</month> <day>30</day> </endDateTime> </salesPeriodDetails>

* * *

## 3.25 Sub Structure: Sequence Identification

## 3.25.1 Description

It conveys the sequence number of the document within the sales report.

The substructure is composed of:

-   The <itemNumberDetails> consisting of elements: the <number> which conveys document sequence number within the sales report, the <type> of the number which is "S" (sequence number).

## 3.25.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<sequenceIdentification> <itemNumberDetails> <number>123456</number> <type>S</type> </itemNumberDetails> </sequenceIdentification>

* * *

## 3.26 Sub Structure: Stock Provider Details

## 3.26.1 Description

It conveys rail stock provider information. It is used when requesting a transaction report on a transaction issued using Rail channel.

This sub structure is composed of:

-   The industry sector :
    -   "RAI" for Rail transactions,
    -   "AIR" for AIR transactions (default if blank)
-   The customer code
    -   2-chars AL Code for AIR
    -   3-chars Distributor Code for Rail

## 3.26.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

* * *

## 3.27 Sub Structure: Transaction Data Details

## 3.27.1 Description

It conveys the transaction data. This sub structure is composed of:

The <transactionDetails\> compose of:

-   The <code> which conveys the transction codes defined by IATA.
-   The <type> which conveys the type of transaction.

## 3.27.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<transactionDataDetails> <transactionDetails> <code>TKTT</code> <type>SALE</type> </transactionDetails> </transactionDataDetails>

* * *

## 3.28 Sub Structure: Validating Carrier Details

## 3.28.1 Description

This substructure conveys the validating carrier 2 letter code. This 2 letter validating carrier code is conveyed under the element called marketing carrier.

For generic Sales, it can contain equivalent carrier code (operating company for Rail transactions).

## 3.28.2 Xml Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

* * *

## 4 Error Messages

**CM# 06466**: NO DATA FOUND

**CM# 05490**: OPTIONS NOT COMBINABLE

**CM#806:** NOT AUTHORISED

**CM# 414**: INTERNAL PROCESSING ERROR

**CM#8656:** DB NOT AVAILABLE - RETRY LATER

**CM#12404** SEQUENCE NUMBER NOT IN DBASE

**CM#10602** DOCUMENT NUMBER NOT PRIMARY OR NOT IN DBASE

**CM# 06452**: INCORRECT CURRENCY

**CM# 00425**: INVALID DATE

**CM# 7794**: INVALID STOCK PROVIDER: an Airline Stock Provider qualifier type code is input but the format is invalid. This error is returned also if both an invalid Airline Stock Provider Qualifier Type code and an invalid Distribution Method Qualifier Type code are input.

**CM# 37327**: INVALID DISTRIBUTION METHOD: a Distribution Method Qualifier Type code is input but the format is invalid

## 4.1 Error Reply

* * *

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<SalesReports\_DisplayQueryReportReply xmlns="http://xml.amadeus.com/TSRQRR\_22\_2\_1A"> <errorGroup> <errorOrWarningCodeDetails> <errorDetails> <errorCode>6466</errorCode> </errorDetails> </errorOrWarningCodeDetails> <errorWarningDescription> <freeTextDetails> <textSubjectQualifier>1</textSubjectQualifier> <source>M</source> <encoding>1</encoding> </freeTextDetails> <freeText>NO DATA FOUND</freeText> </errorWarningDescription> </errorGroup> </SalesReports\_DisplayQueryReportReply>

  

* * *

## 5 Operations

## 5.1 Operation: 1-Reported data issued (without options)

The query report has been requested by an authorized agent and it shows the sales data of the documents issued by this agent against the default currency of the Office Profile.

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

## 5.27 Operation: 33-Reported data issued in a specific Stock (A-xxx or T-xx)

This operation allows the agent to request the display of the transaction sales report of a transaction issued in a different stock provider than the default one of the logged-in office.

## 5.30 Operation: 36- Reported data issued using the EAC product (M-x and T-xx)

  
The query report has been requested by an authorized agent and shows the transactions issued via the EAC product (Product value 'O' in Distribution Method sub-structure) in the Stock Provider specified in the request.

Remark: both Product value 'O' and Stock Provider must be specified in the request.

In the following example, the requested query report shows transactions issued via EAC product in the Stock Provider U2 (EasyJet).

## 5.31 Operation: 37-Reporting data by Pricing indicator

This operation allows the agent to request a Query report with a filtering option on the pricing indicator (auto/manual). The returned Query report will only contain documents having the specified pricing indicator (auto/manual).

In the below example, a Query report of only documents with automated pricing was requested. Only documents with automated pricing indicator are returned in the reply.

## 5.31.1 Query Structure

![](/resources/externalFiles/images/userguideeditor/icon_collapse.gif)XML Example

<SalesReports\_DisplayQueryReport xmlns="http://xml.amadeus.com/TSRQRQ\_22\_2\_1A"> <salesIndicator> <statusInformation> <indicator>PRI</indicator> <action>AUT</action> </statusInformation> </salesIndicator> </SalesReports\_DisplayQueryReport>

## 5.36 Operation: 8-Reported data issued for a specific agent UID and Organization (SUS-xxxxxxxxxx/xxxxxxxxxx)

The TQJ/SUS option is allowing a supervisor to request the sales of another angent based on the couple UserID/Organization as in the following example

In this example the current supervisor 'SUPERUSER" in the organization "ORGA" is requesting the sales of the user "USERID" in the organization "ORGA" for the 15 Dec 2020 

The maximum length of:

-   the requested agent's UserID is set to 10 characters.
-   the requested agent's Organization is set from 2 to 10 characters.

In case of bad formatting, please refer to the error message section.

Supervisor:

-   UserID=SUPERUSER
-   Organization=ORGA
-   Sign= SUPERSIGN

User:

-   UserID=USERID
-   Organization=ORGA
-   Sign=SIGN
